route_scope.exclusion: marketplace commerce routes (marketplace.ts, cart, coupons, offers, wallet, …) are not Vault behaviour; Vault-owned marketplace routes are marketplace-game and marketplace-vault. Known and out of scope: marketplace.ts GET /marketplace/vault-items is a read-only listing query on vault_entries/local_accounts that exists nowhere else, and routes/search.ts, sync.ts, projects.ts, two-factor.ts and services/sync.ts also read vault_entries directly (cross-domain read models, not copies of extracted Vault code)
